claims.claim: Resident individuals are exempt from tax on income without a Georgian source, so US dividends and interest are untaxed locally

sources.name: Tax Code of Georgia, Article 82 (matsne.gov.ge, English consolidated text)
sources.says: Consolidated version shown: 17/12/2025 to 01/04/2026 (the page says it is not the final edition; publications run to 28/10/2026). Article 82(1)(u) exempts "income (including gain) received by a resident natural person, which does not belong to Georgian source income". 82(1)(g) exempts "the value of property received as a gift or inherited by first and second line heirs during a fiscal year"; 82(1)(i) exempts up to GEL 150,000 a year for third and fourth line heirs. 82(4)(c): first line is "spouse, child, adopted child, grandchild, great grandchild and his/her child, parent, adoptive parent"; second line is "sister, brother, niece/nephew and their children". Article 81: taxable income is taxed at 20%. Read at character offsets 200,000 to 300,000 of 397,979.

claims.claim: Property worth at least US$150k at market value (since March 2026, properties can be combined) gives a yearly-renewable temporary permit covering spouse and children

sources.name: Public Service Development Agency of Georgia: residence permits
sources.says: Undated (footer © 2026). Short-term residence permit: for a person who "has the title to an immovable property in the territory of Georgia (except for agricultural land)" with a market value above the GEL equivalent of USD 150,000, set by a certified assessor; the spouse and children may apply. Investment residence permit: an investment of at least USD 300,000 (with yearly turnover of USD 50,000, 100,000 and then 120,000 over five years) or non-agricultural property worth more than USD 300,000; its holders may apply for a residence permit for indefinite stay before the five-year term ends. The permanent residence permit is a separate type (family of citizens, or 10 years on a temporary permit).

sources.name: EIG Law: Georgia to increase real estate investment threshold for residence permits effective March 1, 2026
sources.says: Dated February 27, 2026. From March 1, 2026 the threshold for the temporary residence permit by real estate rises from USD 100,000 to USD 150,000 for new applicants, "as verified by an accredited appraiser", "based on the market value, not the purchase price"; "multiple properties may be combined to reach the required threshold"; the permit is renewed annually and covers the spouse and children. Existing holders renew under the old rules.

also: sources: added the Public Service Development Agency page
claims.note: Also Tbilisi's summary and `why` ("$150k of property gives residence"). The agency's page says the market value must exceed USD 150,000 and calls it the short-term residence permit.
